facts.value: The Department of Economics offers the program Business Chinese with conceptual support and guidance from the field of Sinology. This program consists of 4 courses, starting with a course for beginners with no prior knowledge.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The offer includes levels A1 (Basic Chinese course) and A2 (Business Chinese) according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. After completing the entire program, an oral level close to A1 should be reached.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: This basic course is the first of two basic Chinese courses in the overall program. It is a necessary prerequisite for Basic Chinese Course 2.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: No prior knowledge is required for this module.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The goal of this course is to acquire basic vocabulary and solidify knowledge of the basic structures of the Chinese language. After this course, students should be able to conduct simple dialogues in Chinese and manage typical everyday situations as well as tourist and business stays in China.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Students will acquire linguistic and intercultural skills as well as knowledge about Chinese culture and society, which is beneficial for activities in the field of Chinese-German economic relations and establishing and maintaining contacts with Chinese partners.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Reading comprehension and writing skills will be tested in the form of a 90-minute exam in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for successful completion of the exam.

facts.value: The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 20.
